message:
The scheduled midnight reset of messages_sent_today on all OpenWA Sessions failed.

Sessions that have already reached their daily soft cap will continue to queue or fall back to Meta until the counters are manually reset.

Check the Error Log for details.

To reset manually, run:
frappe.db.sql("UPDATE `tabOpenWA Session` SET messages_sent_today = 0")
name: openwa-counter-reset-failed
subject: ALERT: OpenWA Daily Counter Reset Failed
